sql: SELECT T2.PIM FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens' AND T1.year = 1918
SELECT SUM(CAST(T2.W AS REAL) / T2.G) / COUNT(T2.tmID) FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN TeamsSC AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN T2.birthCountry = 'USA' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.coachID) FROM Coaches AS T1 INNER JOIN Master AS T2 ON T1.coachID = T2.coachID INNER JOIN Teams AS T3 ON T1.tmID = T3.tmID AND T1.year = T3.year WHERE T3.name = 'Montreal Canadiens'
SELECT DISTINCT m.firstName, m.lastName FROM Goalies AS g INNER JOIN Master AS m ON g.playerID = m.playerID WHERE g.tmID = 'BOS' AND g.year = 1972 AND m.coachID IS NOT NULL AND m.hofID IS NULL

SELECT g.playerID FROM Goalies AS g INNER JOIN Teams AS t ON g.tmID = t.tmID AND g.year = t.year WHERE t.name = 'Minnesota North Stars' GROUP BY g.playerID ORDER BY SUM(CAST(g.GA AS INTEGER)) DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.year = 2005 THEN g.GP ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN g.year = 2006 THEN g.GP ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) * 100 / SUM(CASE WHEN g.year = 2005 THEN g.GP ELSE 0 END) FROM Goalies AS g INNER JOIN Master AS m ON g.playerID = m.playerID WHERE m.firstName = 'David' AND m.lastName = 'Aebischer'
SELECT DISTINCT a.coachID FROM AwardsCoaches AS a INNER JOIN Master AS m ON a.coachID = m.coachID WHERE m.playerID IS NULL AND m.coachID IS NOT NULL
SELECT SUM(T1.Pts), T2.coachID FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Coaches AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.tmID = 'ANA' GROUP BY T2.coachID

SELECT DISTINCT m.firstName, m.lastName, g.tmID FROM Master AS m INNER JOIN Goalies AS g ON m.playerID = g.playerID WHERE g.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND m.height <> '' AND m.height IS NOT NULL AND CAST(m.height AS INTEGER) = (SELECT MIN(CAST(m2.height AS INTEGER)) FROM Master AS m2 INNER JOIN Goalies AS g2 ON m2.playerID = g2.playerID WHERE g2.year BETWEEN 1925 AND 1936 AND m2.height <> '' AND m2.height IS NOT NULL)
SELECT CAST(T1.W AS REAL) / T1.G, T2.playerID FROM Teams AS T1 INNER JOIN Scoring AS T2 ON T1.tmID = T2.tmID AND T1.year = T2.year WHERE T1.tmID = 'CAR' AND T1.year = 1998 ORDER BY T2.G DESC LIMIT 1
